audience: inventory and warehouse teams that run stock in Zenventory

useCases.title: Find stock levels and item details
useCases.text: List stock levels per item and warehouse, with filters for low stock. Open one item to see its units and bill of materials.

useCases.title: Review open customer orders
useCases.text: List the customer orders, filtered to open ones. Open one order to see its items and addresses.

useCases.title: Track purchase and transfer orders
useCases.text: List purchase orders by supplier or status, and transfer orders between warehouses.

useCases.title: Create a purchase order to a supplier
useCases.text: Create a purchase order to a supplier. It is saved as a draft unless draft is set to false.

useCases.title: Add a new SKU
useCases.text: Create an inventory item with a new SKU. The item stays in the account until someone edits or deletes it in Zenventory.
